hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStop","additionalContext":"The creator agent has finished making changes. You MUST now: 1) Run /simplify to review the changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency. 2) After /simplify completes, spawn the @validator agent to run content and build validation."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStop","additionalContext":"The validator agent has finished validation. You MUST now spawn the @reviewer agent to verify domain accuracy of the created or modified content."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStop","additionalContext":"The reviewer agent has finished checking domain accuracy. You MUST now spawn the @ux-reviewer agent to check for rendering issues before the ticket can be closed."}}'

STATUS=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.status // empty'); if [ "$STATUS" = "closed" ]; then LATEST=$(ls -t .ux-reviews/*/report.json 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$LATEST" ] || [ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m "$LATEST") )) -gt 1800 ] || [ $(jq '.totalIssues' "$LATEST" 2>/dev/null || echo 1) -gt 0 ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"No recent clean UX review found. You must spawn the @ux-reviewer agent and get a clean report (0 issues) before closing any ticket."}}'; fi; fi
